title: Cozy Cottage Close To Downtown, Broadway & More
description:
The Yellow Cottage is a charming 3-bedroom home built in 1935, full of warmth and character. Located just 4 miles from downtown Nashville and 7 miles from the airport, it’s the perfect home base for exploring Music City. Enjoy easy access to concerts, restaurants, and nightlife, then return to a quiet, comfortable space to relax at the end of the day.

The space
The home features 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, comfortable living spaces and a fully equipped kitchen. Guests have the entire home to themselves, with plenty of space to relax after a day exploring Nashville. A private fenced backyard provides a great outdoor spot to unwind.

Guest access
The entire home is yours during your stay.

Other things to note
A Note About Pricing: Airbnb recently changed how they collect their service fee. Rather than charging guests a separate Airbnb fee during checkout, Airbnb now collects a 15.5% service fee from hosts. As a result, you'll notice that fee is reflected in our nightly rate instead of appearing as a separate charge.
